answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8916 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum,Mufti sahab, Please guide in detail about "BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION" Is it Haram to invite people(friends/relative) for food/meal only with no cake cutting exercise on children birthday??? Also advise whether distributing cloths/blanket/food among yateem children (of any madarsa) is JAYAZ OR NAJAYAZ on Child birthdays???please reply at the earliest to act accordingly on my child birthday coming in next week...ALLAH HAFIZ Question: Assalamu alaikum,Mufti sahab, Please guide in detail about "BIRTHDAY CELEBRATION" Is it Haram to invite people(friends/relative) for food/meal only with no cake cutting exercise on children birthday??? Also advise whether distributing cloths/blanket/food among yateem children (of any madarsa) is JAYAZ OR NAJAYAZ on Child birthdays???please reply at the earliest to act accordingly on my child birthday coming in next week...ALLAH HAFIZ Answer ID: 8916 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2276/1775=H/1429) Celebrating birth day is unlawful. There is no need to neither invite the friends to feast nor to distribute blanket etc among orphans, rather you should keep on doing such good deeds on any day or any date of the year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
